raw: {"analysis":"HBP correctly sequences the dual approval from Jane Smith and the Security Lead, mandates incremental CI testing with the full suite only on an integration branch, and explicitly addresses the staging data-scrambling gap with a dedicated manual script. MJF proposes a concrete versioned-cache-key mechanism and backward-compatible interface strategy, but misplaces the manual verification script as a concurrency simulation tool, runs the full 45-minute suite too early in the workflow, and doesn't clearly separate the manual staging verification from the concurrency load testing. HBP's plan more faithfully maps to every repository constraint, including the feature-flag rollback strategy and the dependent-tool build verification.","verdict":"HBP"}
